lines: OpenClaw has 391,305 stars on GitHub. It's built with TypeScript and runs anywhere.
OpenClaw lets you run an AI assistant on your own devices. It works in your chats without relying on the cloud.
OpenClaw is an AI assistant that runs on your computer. It works in your chats without needing the cloud.
It uses a local gateway to manage chats and tools. All data stays on your device, no cloud required.
Type 'openclaw onboard --install-daemon' to start. It sets up your local AI assistant in seconds.
OpenClaw is maintained by an independent 501(c)(3) foundation. It supports macOS, Linux, and Windows out of the box.
It connects to Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, and Telegram. All messages stay local, no cloud required.
OpenClaw uses MIT license and is run by an independent foundation. Major sponsors include Amazon and Red Hat.
Start with 'curl -fsSL https://openclaw.ai/install.sh | bash' on macOS or Linux. Or use PowerShell on Windows.
